verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no first-party documentation or pricing page details describing how Discord's free tier handles message-history retention versus paid tiers; the Nitro perks listed (emoji, uploads, avatars, cloud gaming) never mention history limits. One community comment even suggests that without paid storage, message history 'disappears after a few thousand messages' in 'slacks and discords,' which further undermines any claim that free-tier teams retain full history. missing for 10: any Discord documentation or pricing page addressing message retention/history limits for free vs. paid servers, and any confirmation that free-tier history is preserved indefinitely.
